none: PAS NLM-C04535: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: P[?TR?]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.8mm, Weight: 1.82gms, die axis: 6
